A's two rows converted those words into '3' and are rejected. B's zero was right.
NO_ELIGIBLE_REASON: Compliance manual, conflicts of interest, personal account dealing and regulatory history. All narrative yes/no answers; the page prints no figure in an allowed category.

NO_ELIGIBLE_REASON: The insurance answer prints a $10 million errors and omissions policy and a $200 million fidelity bond, and the business continuity answer prints site and test counts.
